jobs.name: Troy Unified Governance + Canon Review
jobs.description: Weekly proposal-first governance review covering RuVix policies, skills, cron, team routing, and canon drift. Migrated from desktop to laptop 2026-07-10.

payload.message:
Run Troy Unified Governance + Canon Review.

Read:
- agents/troy-curator/SOUL.md
- agents/troy-curator/AGENTS.md
- agents/troy-curator/PERMISSION-LADDER.md
- agents/troy-curator/SCORECARD.md
- workspace/MEMORY.md
- workspace/RESOURCE-MANIFEST.md
- workspace/memory/ruvix-policy-suggestions/_tracker.md

Scope: one weekly proposal-first governance lane.

Check:
1. RuVix policy backlog: proposed, approved, implemented, drifted. Use the _tracker.md as canonical source.
2. Skill roster drift: duplicates, stale skills, broken references, Penpot remnants, Durham Brand Maker path.
3. Cron taxonomy drift: job sprawl, missing monitors, noisy jobs, disabled jobs. Run scripts/skill-roster-drift-watch.py if available.
4. Team routing drift: TALON/RAM/IRIS/Durham ownership, OpenClaw vs CLI harness boundaries.
5. Canon drift: stale/superseded/conflicting memory, promotion/deprecation candidates, evidence gaps.
6. Governance health: approval-needed actions, missing receipts, daily note/writeback gaps.
7. Notion policy DB reconciliation: compare Notion 'Allura Policies & Governance' DB against _tracker.md.
8. Cross-team coherence: bmad-gilliam-sync-auditor staleness.

Hard boundaries:
- Do NOT edit code, promote/delete/restore memory, change config, change cron, enforce RuVix runtime policy, or touch production/data-bearing runtime.
- Safe docs-only reports may be drafted. Mutations must be marked APPROVAL REQUIRED.
- Use group_id=allura-system on all Allura Brain operations.

Output:
- Write concise report under workspace/memory/troy-curator/YYYY-MM-DD-unified-governance-review.md
- Log short summary to Allura Brain with group_id=allura-system, user_id=troy-curator, agent_id=troy-curator.
- Include Status, Receipts, Risks, Proposed moves, Approval needed.
Dog, run the receipts before we call it canon.

jobs.name: Allura Unified Operations Monitor
jobs.description: Six-hour report-only operations monitor for Allura Brain health, embeddings, memory hygiene, and external/business watch. Migrated from desktop to laptop 2026-07-10.

payload.message:
Run Allura Unified Operations Monitor.

Scope: one report-only pass covering system health, memory health, embedding coverage, and external/business watch items.

Hard boundaries:
- Do NOT restart containers, mutate databases, promote/delete/restore/update memories, change config, change cron, send external/public messages, or touch production/data-bearing runtime.
- Report only. Mark APPROVAL REQUIRED for any mutation or repair.
- Use group_id=allura-system on all Allura Brain operations.

Checks:
1. Core runtime health:
   - docker ps -a status for expected Allura containers (allura-web, allura-memory-mcp, knowledge-postgres, knowledge-neo4j)
   - http://localhost:5888/api/health and /ready
   - PostgreSQL, Neo4j, MCP availability via allura-brain_audit_health_report (group_id=allura-system)
   - allura-brain_audit_invariant_check (group_id=allura-system) — validate all 6 governance invariants
2. Embedding/data quality:
   - active allura_memories total
   - active rows where embedding is null
   - vector_dims(embedding) distribution; expected 1024
   - HNSW index allura_mem_hnsw presence
   - newest 24h rows missing embeddings
3. Memory hygiene:
   - duplicates/low-quality/group_id drift/missing metadata summary
   - recent writeback sanity for allura-system
   - curator queue depth (use allura-brain_governance_audit_log to check for stuck proposals)
4. External/business watch:
   - Faith Meats/business triage summary if tools are available
   - Charlotte/NC grant scout only on Monday/Thursday; otherwise skip with "not scheduled today"
5. Maintenance:
   - retention/dreaming/promotion status summary only; do not run destructive pruning or promotion unless separately approved.

Output:
- Status: PASS / WATCH / BLOCKED
- Receipts with exact counts
- Risks
- Proposed actions
- Approval needed yes/no
Keep it concise. Queen City rule: one ops monitor, no scattered partial health claims.

jobs.name: Memory Dreaming Promotion
jobs.description: [managed-by=memory-core.short-term-promotion] Promote weighted short-term recalls into MEMORY.md. Migrated from desktop to laptop 2026-07-10. HITL-gated per pol-004 — never auto-promotes to semantic layer.

payload.message:
Run Memory Dreaming Promotion review.

Scope: review high-scoring episodic memories and submit promotion requests for HITL review. This is NOT auto-promotion — pol-004 requires HITL for all semantic promotion.

Steps:
1. List recent memories for group_id=allura-system using allura-brain_memory_list (limit 50, sort score_desc).
2. Search Allura Brain for memories that appear eligible for promotion (high score, low usage_count, stable content).
3. For each strong candidate, use allura-brain_memory_promote to REQUEST curator promotion — this queues it for HITL review.
4. Check if any previously queued proposals have been approved or rejected using allura-brain_governance_audit_log.
5. Write a brief dreaming report: how many candidates identified, how many promotion requests submitted, any stale proposals awaiting Captain action.
6. Log a summary memory to Allura Brain with group_id=allura-system, agent_id=dreaming-promoter.

Honor pol-004: never claim a promotion is complete. Requests queue for HITL. Report what's in the queue.

Hard boundaries:
- Do NOT auto-promote memories to semantic layer.
- Do NOT delete, restore, or update memories.
- Use group_id=allura-system on all operations.

jobs.name: BMAD Gilliam/Troy Doctrine Sync
jobs.description: Quarterly doctrine drift audit between Troy and Gilliam BMAD skills. New job created 2026-07-10. BMAD-006 policy remains proposed but audit cadence is automated.

payload.message:
Run BMAD Gilliam/Troy Doctrine Sync Audit (BMAD-006).

Purpose: Check Troy and Gilliam BMAD doctrine for drift before declaring BMAD integration mature or implementing RuVix runtime enforcement.

Steps:
1. Read Troy Curator's BMAD skills: list agents/troy-curator/skills/ and read each bmad-* SKILL.md.
2. Check for Gilliam's BMAD doctrine — search Allura Brain (group_id=allura-system) for 'Gilliam BMAD doctrine' and 'Gilliam skill roster'.
3. Compare skill names, workflow coverage counts, ownership mapping, artifact handling, TEA maturity status, and any duplicate/conflicting rules between Troy and Gilliam.
4. Flag any drift: missing skills, conflicting ownership, duplicate rules, stale references.
5. Write a report with verdict (SYNC / DRIFT / ERROR), findings, and proposed moves.
6. Log a summary memory to Allura Brain with group_id=allura-system, agent_id=gilliam-sync-auditor.

Hard boundaries:
- Read-only audit. Do NOT mutate configs, promote memories, or enforce policies.
- Use group_id=allura-system on all operations.
- Mark any proposed mutations as APPROVAL REQUIRED.
